title: Invitation to Tender: Strategy Development Partner Commission
description: We are looking for an experienced partner to lead a genuinely participatory strategy development process across nine regions in England. The indicative budget is £100,000 plus VAT, with proposals due by 24 August 2026.
body: The Phoenix Community Trust is seeking an external partner to lead a comprehensive and genuinely participatory strategy development process, working with communities and partners across nine regions in England.
The appointed partner will deliver discovery research, stakeholder interviews, nine regional convenings and a programme of digital engagement before producing a final strategy framework for TPCT.

We are looking for providers with a strong track record in participatory strategy development, anti-racist practice and community engagement at scale. Experience working with Global Majority communities and within racial justice or social justice contexts is essential.
Partnership and consortium bids are actively encouraged, particularly where they enable smaller or Global Majority-led organisations to participate competitively.
The indicative budget is £100,000 plus VAT where applicable, inclusive of all provider fees, participant costs and other delivery expenses.

Key dates — Supplier webinar: 23 July 2026, 11:45am–12:30pm. Expression of Interest deadline: 31 July 2026 at 5pm. Full proposal deadline: 24 August 2026 at 9am. Shortlisted provider interviews: 3 and 4 September 2026. Commission expected to be confirmed: Mid-September 2026.
